issues.summary: isSafe failures are swallowed by a bare catch with no logging
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: space-counterfactual-safes.service.ts:70-72 returns false with no log, and the service injects no LoggingService. Failing open is intended per the PR description, but an outage or a Zod/chain error leaves no trace. That is an observability gap, not a behaviour defect.

issues.summary: The e2e tests never exercise the deployed-Safe filter; they pass through the fail-open catch
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The e2e spec uses createTestModule with TestNetworkModule (testing-module.ts:83-84), a bare mock, so getApi/isSafe throws and the catch at service.ts:70 keeps every row. No e2e case filters out a deployed Safe, but the new unit spec covers the filtering logic, so a regression would still be caught.

issues.summary: The user-scoped endpoint is not filtered, and nothing deletes CF rows on deployment
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: counterfactual-safes.service.ts:46-58 returns findByUserId results unfiltered. That code is outside this PR's diff, and the PR description explicitly defers write-side hardening and stale-row cleanup to a follow-up.

issues.summary: spaceId is a UUID string, but Space['id'] is a number; `as never` casts hide the mismatch
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: space.entity.db.ts declares `id!: number`, while the spec at line 44 uses faker.string.uuid() and casts `spaceId as never` at lines 75, 97, 113, 123, 133 and 165. The tests still run because the mocks ignore the value, but the casts defeat type checking.

issues.summary: Member fixtures are plain `{ id } as never` objects instead of memberBuilder
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Spec lines 60-62, 88-90, 106, 120, 150 and 131 cast plain objects to never, although src/modules/users/datasources/entities/__tests__/member.entity.db.builder.ts exists. This is a test-style issue with no functional impact.

issues.summary: `as unknown as MockedObject` cast on repository mocks
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Spec line 17 uses `as unknown as MockedObject<...>`, the same pattern found in about 15 other files in src. It is established repo convention and has no cost.

issues.summary: The 'returns undeployed counterfactual safes' test is redundant
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Spec lines 82-100 only check length, and the tests at lines 49 and 137 already cover undeployed pass-through with stronger assertions. The redundancy has no concrete cost.

issues.summary: The non-member test uses rejects.toThrow() with no expected error
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Spec line 133 accepts any error. assertMember throws ForbiddenException('User is not a member of this workspace') (space-assert.utils.ts:58), and asserting that would prove the membership check fired. The not-called assertion on findBySpaceId only partly compensates.

issues.summary: No test asserts the chainId passed to isSafe
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The mocks at spec lines 71-73 and 161-163 match on address only, and no assertion checks the isSafe call arguments. A regression that passed the wrong chainId at service.ts:67 would go undetected by these tests.
